subject: Request for PO policy edge-case / onboarding clearance - QuantaLabs pilot
messages:
From: Natalie Reyes <natalie@quantalabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding for 60-day pilot - request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Hi Hannah,

Quick intro — I’m Natalie in Procurement at QuantaLabs. We’re running a 60-day technical pilot with your team starting next week (engineering signed off). Procurement typically requires purchase orders, but for small, time-boxed pilots we prefer an invoice-only path so we can move faster on SOW signatures and installations.

Estimated spend for the pilot: ~$12,000.
Can Redwood offer a temporary no-PO onboarding for this pilot while we complete vendor setup? We can provide W-9, insurance, and a short SOW. Our legal is fine with a limited-term SOW but procurement wants confirmation from your side that we can invoice Redwood net30 and that accounts payable will accept invoice-only for this pilot.

Attached: quanta_vendor_info.xlsx (vendor contact fields) — I’ll follow up with W-9 and SOW shortly.

Thanks,
Natalie Reyes
Procurement Lead, QuantaLabs
procurement@quantalabs.com
+1 415-555-0190

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reyes <natalie@quantalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding for 60-day pilot - request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Hi Natalie — thanks for the note and welcome.

We can accommodate an invoice-only path for a limited pilot, but we need sign-off from Finance and a short checklist completed before we open the vendor profile. Can you send the W-9 and the SOW draft? Once I have those I’ll loop in Karthik to confirm temporary approval limits and any upfront holdback requirements.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Please attach W-9 and SOW (we’ll keep versioning light for pilot).
- We’ll run a quick vendor risk check (insurance + W-9) — Logan handles the vendor intake.
- Finance (Karthik) to confirm one-time exception: invoice-only, up to $15k, 60 days.

I attached our onboarding form to speed things along: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fill basic tax/legal fields). If this passes Finance and vendor check, Marissa will approve commercial terms and we’ll accept invoices net30 for pilot.

Feel free to include anyone else on the Quanta side.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AM (Sales Ops) | Redwood Inference
Work: 510-555-0122

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding for 60-day pilot - request for invoice-only path (no PO)

On Mon, Aug 23, 2027 at 11:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> We can accommodate an invoice-only path for a limited pilot...

All — quick finance read: we can grant a temporary invoice-only onboarding as a one-time procurement exception provided the following are met:
- Signed SOW with scope and capped not-to-exceed amount ($15,000).
- W-9 and certificate of insurance on file.
- AP to be instructed to route invoices to the pilot cost center; net30 payment terms.
- Flag the account: auto-escalate to Finance if cumulative spend > $15k during the pilot.

I ran a preliminary risk check; nothing blocking but I’m attaching a short finance assessment with recommended guardrails. If Legal needs to redline the SOW, we prefer minimal edits for the pilot (limiting term/liability to the SOW).

I’ll approve a one-time exception once W-9 + SOW + onboarding form are received and Logan confirms vendor intake.

-Karthik
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: finance-risk-assessment.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reyes <natalie@quantalabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding for 60-day pilot - request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Thanks everyone — inbound materials look good.

Natalie, good to meet you. Per the checklist: we received QuantaLabs W-9 and the SOW draft, and Logan confirmed vendor intake passed basic checks. Karthik and I discussed commercial risk and we are comfortable approving a temporary invoice-only onboarding for this pilot with the following conditions:

- Pilot cap: $15,000 total spend over 60 days.
- Payment terms: net30 from invoice date; QuantaLabs invoices to AP-pilot@redwood.com.
- Contracts: execute the attached one-page pilot SOW, minimal legal redlines only (we added a single clause limiting liability to fees paid for the pilot).
- Evidence: QuantaLabs to provide W-9 and COI (certificate of insurance) before first invoice.
- Escalation: automatic alert to Finance and Sales if spend reaches 80% of cap.

I’ve attached the signed internal approval form: approved_po_exception_form.pdf — this is the one-time procurement exception. Please complete the vendor onboarding form that Hannah sent and return the signed SOW via DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/Redwood/Envelope/BA4F3C.

Hannah — please add the deal to HubSpot (link below) and confirm AP routing. Natalie — once DocuSign is complete we’ll spin up the vendor profile and accept the first invoice.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-98765

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

Attachment: approved_po_exception_form.pdf
